notes: Printed (M21 originalText and current Oracle): 'As long as you control a creature with power 4 or greater, this creature can attack as though it didn't have defender.' There is no 'another': the Gatherer ruling of 2020-06-23 reads 'If Drowsing Tyrannodon's power is raised to 4 or greater, it will allow itself to attack.' Alone and 3/3 it can't attack; after Defiant Strike (+1/+0, and draw a card) it is 4/3 and attacks for 4 (20 -> 16). Pinned 2026-11-05 because an audit read the card as 'another creature' and asked for a fix: the compiled condition without FNot(IS_SOURCE) is the printed card.
